verdict.summary: Round 3 remains correct and complete. Focused tests exercise empty rejection, verbatim preservation, generated shape and non-repetition, end-to-end propagation on the real contract path, and mismatch rejection. The dependency remains optional and expression-feature-gated, the public API documentation is updated, and the honesty-sensitive text accurately calls this hardening rather than a freshness or soundness guarantee while retaining the pending external-audit caveat.
